process_area.title: Impact Measurement, Fair-Trade Compliance & Development Program

fields.Participants: Sustainability Lead, Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Coop Representatives, Impact Analyst
fields.Trigger: Quarterly impact cycle; coop onboarding; program milestone
fields.Volume: All active coop suppliers and beneficiaries

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-reconcile of "reconcile to BuildRight payments" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Sustainability Lead publishes impact scorecard into BuildRight ESG system" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-513 (ensure controlled execution — Impact Measurement, Fair-Trade Compliance & Development Program (PA-94.3).)
- operational: triangulation, sampling audit, and third-party verification (W3130)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-credibility risk**: Self-reported coop data may be inflated; mitigated by triangulation, sampling audit, and third-party verification (W3130)
System Touchpoints: - Impact register; ESG scorecard (links to VS-25); records retention (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Sustainability Lead defines impact KPIs aligned to recognized frameworks (GRI, IRIS+, SDGs): livelihoods supported, direct beneficiaries (coop members + dependents), fair-wage premium paid vs. prevailing, training hours delivered, community projects co-funded

Impact Analyst collects verified data per coop: member roster, wage/earnings uplift (baseline vs. current), training completion, infrastructure/equipment invested; reconcile to BuildRight payments (W3126) and capacity programs (W3117)
Sustainability Lead publishes impact scorecard into BuildRight ESG system (links to VS-25); auditable evidence retained (records — links to VS-88); feeds external reporting (W3130, W3132)

fields.Participants: Sustainability Lead, Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Third-Party Auditor, Coop Representatives, Legal
fields.Trigger: Certification cycle; new coop; certification renewal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "enterprise cert, ethical-sourcing audit" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Auditor conducts on-site audit" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-513 (ensure controlled execution — Impact Measurement, Fair-Trade Compliance & Development Program (PA-94.3).)
- operational: certification calendar and renewal alerts
Pain Points / Risks: - **Certification-lapse risk**: Lapsed cert invalidates fair-trade claim; mitigated by certification calendar and renewal alerts
System Touchpoints: - Certification register; audit findings/CAPA; records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Sustainability Lead selects appropriate certification (WFTO, local fair-trade body, Go Lokal!, social-enterprise cert, ethical-sourcing audit); engage accredited third-party auditor

Auditor conducts on-site audit: fair-wage compliance, no child/forced labor (links to VS-86), safe working conditions (links to VS-24), environmental compliance (links to VS-25/VS-73), traceability and records (links to VS-88), governance

Sustainability Lead closes any non-conformities via capacity-building (W3117); publishes certification status; uses certification in marketing claims (links to VS-14/VS-25) and as anti-greenwashing safeguard

fields.Participants: Sustainability Lead, Impact Analyst, Coop Representatives, Government Partners

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-create of "Impact Analyst measures livelihood outcomes per coop" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports to government livelihood partners" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-513 (ensure controlled execution — Impact Measurement, Fair-Trade Compliance & Development Program (PA-94.3).)
- operational: conservative attribution and baseline-control methodology
Pain Points / Risks: - **Attribution risk**: Outcomes influenced by many factors beyond BuildRight; mitigated by conservative attribution and baseline-control methodology
System Touchpoints: - Impact register (links to W3129); ESG reporting (links to VS-25); government-partner reporting

steps.activity: Impact Analyst measures livelihood outcomes per coop: household income uplift, poverty-line graduation, employment created (full-time/equivalent), women/youth/indigenous representation, asset accumulation
Sustainability Lead reports to government livelihood partners (DSWD-SLP, DOLE, DTI-BMED — links to W3119) per MOA; complies with partner data standards; supports program renewal
Sustainability Lead publishes anonymized aggregate outcomes in BuildRight ESG report (links to VS-25) and annual report; informs strategy refinement (W3113) and capacity-building (W3117)

fields.Participants: Sustainability Lead, Marketing (links to VS-14), Legal, DPO (links to VS-91), Coop Representatives
fields.Trigger: Annual ESG report; marketing campaign; product storytelling need

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Legal/DPO review claims" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track engagement and sales lift" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-513 (ensure controlled execution — Impact Measurement, Fair-Trade Compliance & Development Program (PA-94.3).)
- operational: documented consent and IP review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Consent/IP risk**: Unauthorized use of artisan likeness/indigenous design triggers privacy/IP claim; mitigated by documented consent and IP review
System Touchpoints: - DAM/content (links to VS-14); ecommerce (links to VS-10); retail-media (links to VS-48); privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: Sustainability Lead/Marketing develop authentic storytelling content: coop/artisan stories, product provenance, impact metrics, photo/video with informed consent (links to VS-91 data privacy and IPRA W3134 for indigenous)
Legal/DPO review claims (anti-greenwashing — DTI fair-trade), consent/privacy (links to VS-91), and IP/indigenous-cultural-property rights (links to W3134); approve before publication
Marketing publishes via channels (links to VS-14), ecommerce product pages (links to VS-10), retail-media (links to VS-48), and marketplace listings (links to VS-65); track engagement and sales lift

fields.Participants: Sustainability Lead, Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Capacity-Building Partner, Coop Representatives
fields.Trigger: Coop achieves capability threshold; capacity-build milestone; multi-buyer diversification need
fields.Volume: Subset of coops ready to graduate

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "record graduation outcome in impact tracker" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-513 (ensure controlled execution — Impact Measurement, Fair-Trade Compliance & Development Program (PA-94.3).)
- operational: readiness criteria and gradual transition
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-graduation risk**: Premature graduation strains coop; mitigated by readiness criteria and gradual transition
System Touchpoints: - Vendor master (links to VS-03/VS-29); impact tracker (links to W3129); capacity-building tracker

steps.activity: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr assesses coop readiness to graduate to mainstream vendor (links to VS-03) or scale to larger offtake: capability, consistency, business maturity, certifications (W3130)
Capacity-Building Partner delivers graduation program: business/financial management, multi-buyer prospecting, contract/legal literacy, digital tools; reduce single-buyer dependency risk
Sustainability Sourcing Mgr transitions graduated coop to mainstream vendor master (links to VS-03) or expanded coop role; record graduation outcome in impact tracker (links to W3129)

fields.Participants: Sustainability Lead, Legal, NCIP Liaison, Indigenous Community Representatives, Sustainability Sourcing Mgr
fields.Trigger: Indigenous-community sourcing opportunity; ancestral-domain product (handicraft, forest materials, traditional knowledge)

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "Legal structures benefit-sharing, intellectual property" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-extract of "extraction without consent, benefit-share audit, and storytelling only with FPIC" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-513 (ensure controlled execution — Impact Measurement, Fair-Trade Compliance & Development Program (PA-94.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Biopiracy / cultural-appropriation risk**: Unauthorized use of traditional knowledge/design; mitigated by FPIC and IP/benefit-share agreements
System Touchpoints: - FPIC/NCIP record; IP/benefit-share register (links to VS-36); impact tracker (links to W3129)

steps.activity: Sustainability Lead/NCIP Liaison engage indigenous community per Indigenous Peoples Rights Act (IPRA / RA 8371): Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) through NCIP process; respect ancestral-domain sovereignty and community decision structures

Legal structures benefit-sharing, intellectual property (traditional designs, cultural heritage), and Cultural Heritage / Traditional Knowledge agreements; ensure fair share of proceeds flows to community per NCIP-approved plan

Sustainability Lead implements ongoing engagement: respect community protocols, no extraction without consent, benefit-share audit, and storytelling only with FPIC (links to W3132); report outcomes (links to W3129)

fields.Participants: Sustainability Lead, Internal Audit (links to VS-21), Legal, Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Coop Representatives
fields.Trigger: Periodic risk review; whistleblower/alert; audit finding

Automation Opportunity: - System continuous audit of "Sustainability Lead/Internal Audit" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-detect of "For flagged risk" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports anti-exploitation outcomes to Board/ESG committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-513 (ensure controlled execution — Impact Measurement, Fair-Trade Compliance & Development Program (PA-94.3).)
- operational: direct-to-beneficiary settlement (W3126) and member-level verification
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-exploitation risk**: BuildRight's fair-trade price skimmed by middleman before reaching artisans; mitigated by direct-to-beneficiary settlement (W3126) and member-level verification
System Touchpoints: - Whistleblower (links to VS-21/VS-86); audit findings; ESG governance (links to VS-36/VS-25)

steps.activity: Sustainability Lead/Internal Audit (links to VS-21) screen coops for exploitation risk: coercion, middleman skim of fair-trade price, child/forced labor (links to VS-86), unsafe conditions (links to VS-24), environmental harm (links to VS-25/VS-73); whistleblower channel available

For flagged risk: investigate; engage coop leadership and members separately to detect middleman/coercion; remediate via governance support, capacity-building (W3117), or sanctions/offboarding (W3120)
Sustainability Lead reports anti-exploitation outcomes to Board/ESG committee (links to VS-36/VS-25); ensures safeguards auditable by third parties (W3130) and regulators

fields.Participants: Sustainability Lead, Finance, BI (links to VS-28), Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Category (links to VS-01)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measure commercial outcomes" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews ROI and impact" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-513 (ensure controlled execution — Impact Measurement, Fair-Trade Compliance & Development Program (PA-94.3).)
- operational: balanced scorecard and willingness-to-pay research (links to VS-44)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sub-economic program risk**: Impact without commercial viability is unsustainable; mitigated by balanced scorecard and willingness-to-pay research (links to VS-44)
System Touchpoints: - BI dashboards (links to VS-28); financial cost model (links to VS-17); impact scorecard (links to VS-25/W3129)

steps.activity: BI/Finance (links to VS-28) compute program economics: total coop spend, fair-wage premium, capacity-building investment, advance-financing cost, defect/return cost, vs. mainstream baseline; compute cost-per-impact (livelihood, beneficiary)
Sustainability Lead/Category measure commercial outcomes: sell-through, margin, customer preference for fair-trade, brand-equity lift (links to VS-14/VS-44); compare vs. mainstream equivalent SKUs
Steering committee reviews ROI and impact; rebalances portfolio (add/exit coops — W3114/W3120), adjusts capacity-building allocation, refines strategy (W3113); reports to Board/ESG committee
